title: My Bathroom Door Has 1,024 LOCKS
premise: In our apartment building, closing a door doubles its locks and the locks never come off, so everybody lives with their doors open. I have never closed one. My big sister Jade slams them, and we fight for the one bathroom at 7:15 every morning, until our bathroom door is a brass bulge of 1,024 locks leaning into the hall.
twist: A lock's keyhole flap is a little door too, so one flap swinging shut gives its lock a lock and the door doubles itself with nobody touching it. The locks never come off, but the door does: we carry it down to the curb, and Mr. Dale across the hall takes it home, where it starts pushing on his own front door.
world: a bright four-floor city apartment building: mint hall with a terracotta floor and open front doors, a sky-blue apartment with a short inner hall and one yellow bathroom door, a downstairs kitchen, a stairwell and a sunny curb
